#!/bin/bash
#FLUX --account=pXXXX  ## YOUR ACCOUNT pXXXX or bXXXX
#FLUX --queue=short  ### PARTITION (buyin, short, normal, etc)
#FLUX --nodes=2 ## how many computers do you need
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=4 ## how many cpus or processors do you need on each computer
#FLUX --time=00:20:00 ## how long does this need to run (remember different partitions have restrictions on this param)
# NOTE: Flux does not have a --mem-per-cpu option. Since cpus-per-task defaults to 1,
# this is equivalent to --mem-per-task.
#FLUX --mem-per-task=1G ## how much RAM do you need per CPU
#FLUX --job-name=sample_job  ## When you run squeue -u NETID this is how you can identify the job
#FLUX --output=outlog_nwchem_7_0_2_intel ## standard out and standard error goes to this file
#FLUX -C "quest8|quest9|quest10|quest11"

module purge all
module load nwchem/7.0.2-openmpi-4.0.5-intel-19.0.5.281 

# 'mpirun' is replaced by 'flux run'. The SLURM_NTASKS variable is replaced
# by the Flux equivalent, FLUX_JOB_NUM_TASKS. The '-n' flag is not strictly
# necessary as 'flux run' will default to using all allocated tasks.
flux run -n ${FLUX_JOB_NUM_TASKS} nwchem nwch.nw
#srun --mpi=pmix_v3 -n ${SLURM_NTASKS} nwchem nwch.nw

reasons: The format of the constraint directive '#FLUX -C "quest8|quest9|quest10|quest11"' is invalid. Flux's '--constraint' option in a batch script does not interpret '|' as a logical OR operator; it expects a single, valid feature name. The entire string, including the '|' characters, would be treated as the name of the required feature, which is unlikely to exist.
issues: The account is set to a placeholder value ('#FLUX --account=pXXXX'). The job submission will fail until this is replaced with a valid account name.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --account=pXXXX  ## YOUR ACCOUNT pXXXX or bXXXX
#SBATCH --partition=short  ### PARTITION (buyin, short, normal, etc)
#SBATCH --nodes=2 ## how many computers do you need
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4 ## how many cpus or processors do you need on each computer
#SBATCH --time=00:20:00 ## how long does this need to run (remember different partitions have restrictions on this param)
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=1G ## how much RAM do you need per CPU (this effects your FairShare score so be careful to not ask for more than you need))
#SBATCH --job-name=sample_job  ## When you run squeue -u NETID this is how you can identify the job
#SBATCH --output=outlog_nwchem_7_0_2_intel ## standard out and standard error goes to this file
#SBATCH --constraint="[quest8|quest9|quest10|quest11]"

module purge all
module load nwchem/7.0.2-openmpi-4.0.5-intel-19.0.5.281 

mpirun -np ${SLURM_NTASKS} nwchem nwch.nw
#srun --mpi=pmix_v3 -n ${SLURM_NTASKS} nwchem nwch.nw
